cosmic-violet.$description: Cosmic Violet — Primary brand ink — outlined button borders, heading text on light surfaces, the only chromatic voice in the UI

twilight-indigo.$description: Twilight Indigo — Deeper violet for secondary borders and gradient origins — bridges Cosmic Violet into the atmospheric range

aurora-teal.$description: Aurora Teal — Atmospheric teal pulled from the hero photography — background washes and the emotional color of the brand

cyan-glow.$description: Cyan Glow — Terminal stop of the radial atmospheric gradients — recreates the directional key light of the hero at smaller scales; Decorative radial gradient that recreates the hero's directional teal light in section panels

cosmic-violet-wash.$description: Cosmic Violet Wash — Decorative violet gradient for atmospheric panels

polar-white.$description: Polar White — Primary text on the dark hero, light section surfaces, card backgrounds, button text on violet

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Text on light surfaces and deepest contrast points

silver-slate.$description: Silver Slate — Near-gray stroke color for subtle decorative lines and secondary UI elements

cerulean-mist.$description: Cerulean Mist — Decorative SVG stroke for iconography and illustration accents

storm-shadow.$description: Storm Shadow — Muted blue used for link focus-ring shadows and hover glows

twklausanne-250.$description: Body, UI, and mid-tier headings — the workhorse family. 400 for paragraphs and descriptions, 700 for sub-headings and emphasized labels. The tight 1.13 line-height at 40px gives mid-headings a compressed, architectural feel

twklausanne-200.$description: Display and hero headlines — the lightest cut of TWKLausanne acts as an anti-convention choice: most brands shout at 80px with bold weights, this one whispers at 400 and achieves presence through restraint and aggressive negative tracking

neosanspro-medium.$description: Architectural all-caps labels — nav links, scroll cues, section markers, brand wordmark. The 2.0–3.0 line-height at 10px creates dramatic vertical breathing room, and the extreme +0.32em tracking turns tiny text into spatial markers rather than readable labels

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
